services.name: Youth Classes
services.desc: In this class, students will have the opportunity to work in ceramics in an open studio environment where they can focus on their own chosen body of work through handbuilding and wheel throwing. Ceramic techniques and instructor consultation will be available in the studio as needed. It is a great space to build a body of work surrounded by other ceramicists in a supportive artistic community. services.name: Venue Rentals
services.desc: Whether you are planning an intimate gathering or a 300-guest wedding ceremony and reception, the Shemer Art Center is a unique location at which to hold a private event. If interested, we encourage you to review the following information and then explore the opportunity to hold your event at the Shemer Art Center, in one of the many areas available on our grounds. Typical venue rentals include weddings, receptions, rehearsal dinners, anniversary and birthday parties, Bar Mitzvahs, group meetings, retreats, luncheons, and holiday parties.
